name: 7R-Kanae
source:
As a fragment of Risu's sins of the past, Kanae wants to be the strongest android. In order to achieve that, she will do anything, even killing her own creator, Dr. Akagi, knowing that only he can stop her. With unlimited bloodthirst to be quenched, she's on her way to fight Risu in her most fragile state.

[Taken from [url=https://twitter.com/KalongStudio/status/1145325154760663040/photo/1]Twitter[/url]]
